test_run.note: Limitations are pre-existing PDFTalk auth/logging issues, not Sentinel defects. See integration-test-report.md.

tests.name: redis_state_inspection
tests.expected: sentinel:v1:<sha256>:<endpoint>:<version> key, TTL ~120s, state string current:previous:window_start
tests.actual: string key, VALUE '3:0:...', TTL 108s, MEMORY_USAGE 176 bytes

tests.name: redis_failure_fail_closed
tests.expected: 503 rate limiter unavailable, no upload side effects

tests.name: multi_process_shared_limit
tests.actual: A:202, B:202, A:202, B:429; single shared Redis key count=3

tests.name: multi_user_independent_limits
tests.expected: user A 3 allowed + denied; user B 1st allowed
tests.actual: A: 202,202,202,429; B: 202; two distinct hashed keys

tests.name: authentication_interaction
tests.actual: missing/malformed/expired JWT -> 401; nonexistent user -> 401; non-UUID sub -> 500 (pre-existing PDFTalk bug in get_current_user, not Sentinel)

tests.name: script_reload_restart
tests.expected: app continues functioning after Redis restart (NoScriptError recovery)
tests.actual: scripts flushed (0 0), auto re-loaded on demand (0 1), full cycle 202,202,202,429 post-restart

tests.name: observability_no_secret_leakage
tests.expected: decisions observable, no JWT/password in logs
tests.actual: metrics carry decision_reason (allowed=3, rate_limited=1); 0 JWT-like strings; 0 redis passwords in logs; sentinel structured extra fields dropped by PDFTalk logging config
